Short Information : has released the result for the Non Technical Popular Categories Assistant Loco Pilot (ALP) posts. RRB has invited huge number of vacancies for Assistant Loco Pilot (ALP) post recruitment during the 12 April 2025, to 19 May 2025. There were 10,970 posts were called for the hiring of RRB ALP in various trades. The CBT examination was held from 13, 16, 17 & 18 February 2026 & 11 March 2026. Candidates who appeared for this examination can check their RRB ALP 01/2025 CBT-I Result 2026 from the link given below.

Railway RRB ALP Bharti 2025 : Educational Qualification

  • Candidates who have passed their Class 10th / High School Examination with ITI Certificate in relevant trade will be eligible for this recruitment. OR
  • Candidates who have Degree / Diploma in Engineering from any recognized University in India will be eligible for this recruitment.
  • All candidates must read the official information completely before applying.

Railway RRB ALP Recruitment 2025 : Mode of Selection

  • CBT-1
  • CBT-II
  • CBAT
  • Document Verification
  • Medical Exam

How To Download RRB ALP 01/2025 Result 2026

  • Candidates must go to the Important Links section below
  • Then the candidates must click on the Download Result link.                  
  • After clicking on the link, the candidates will be redirected to a new page.
  • In this page, candidates have to enter the following details:
  • Registration no.
  • Login ID
  • Birth Date/Password
  • Captcha Code
  • Then the candidates have to  submit the details by clicking on the Login button.
  • After successful login, candidates will be able to download the result.
  • Alternatively, the candidates can download the RRB ALP 01/2025 result 2026 from the official website of RRB also.

Important Question

Q. When will RRB ALP 01/2025 Result2026 be released?
Answer. The RRB ALP 01/2025 Result 2026 has been released on the official RRB website.

Q. How can I check the RRB ALP 01/2025 Result 2026?
Answer. Visit the official RRB website, click on the ALP Result link, and check your result using your roll number.

Q. In which format will the result be released?
Answer. The result will be released in PDF format with the roll numbers of qualified candidates.

Q. What is the next step after qualifying the exam?
Answer. Qualified candidates will be called for CBT 2 exam, document verification, and medical test.

Q. Will the cut-off marks be released with the result?
Answer. Yes, the cut-off marks are usually released along with or after the result.

Q. Where will the RRB ALP 01/2025 Result 2026 be published?
Answer. The result will be published on the official regional websites of the Railway Recruitment Board.

Q. What is RRB Official Website?
Answer. The Official Website of RRB is https://indianrailways.gov.in/
